(Photo by Isaiah Vazquez/Getty Images)Getty ImagesIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Thomas Lagrone | tlagrone@al.comThe Philadelphia 76ers play against the Orlando Magic in the NBA Play-In Tournament today. The game will begin at 6:30 p.m. CT on Prime Video. The winner of this game will secure the No. 7 seed in the Eastern Conference, while the loser will compete for the No. 8 seed on Friday.How long does Prime Video’s free trial last?Prime Video currently offers a 30-day free trial to new users, which will help basketball fans catch most of the NBA Playoffs this year. Notably, the rest of the NBA Play-In Tournament will also be broadcasted on Prime Video. The 76ers ended the regular season with a 45-37 record, and they have won back-to-back games. In their most recent game, the 76ers defeated the Milwaukee Bucks 126-106. In order to win this game, the 76ers will need to rely on their star guard Tyrese Maxey. He leads the team in points and assists, as he averages 28 points and six assists per game.The Magic also ended the year with a 45-37 record, but they are coming off a 113-108 loss against the Boston Celtics. In order to bounce back today, the Magic will need a great performance from their forward Paolo Banchero. He leads the team in points and rebounds, as he averages 22 points and eight rebounds per game.
